name: Nike Supreme x Dunk High Pro SB 'Red'
story_html: Alongside two additional colorways, the Supreme x Dunk High Pro SB 'Red' made up the second collaboration between Nike SB and Supreme. The high-top sports gold stars and crocodile-textured overlays, the latter included in lieu of Tinker Hatfield’s elephant print. The two-tone white and red design is finished with a choice of three lace colors and a metallic gold Supreme lace jewel.
